subject: Consolidated contract & integration quote request: HubSpot Sales Hub + Outreach connector
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@hubspot.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@outreach.io>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated quote request: HubSpot Sales Hub + Outreach connector

Hi Claire and Samir —

Quick context: Redwood is approaching our annual procurement window and want to explore a consolidated commercial path for Sales engagement tooling. We currently use HubSpot Sales Hub (CRM + sequences) and Outreach for advanced sequence orchestration. Rather than separate renewals, the GTM and revenue ops teams prefer a single negotiated contract (or tightly linked contracts) that includes the Outreach-HubSpot connector, SSO/SCIM provisioning, and basic migration assistance.

High-level asks:
- Consolidated 12-month pricing for approx 120 sales seats (we can split if needed between core CRM seats and sequence licenses)
- Migration/onboarding SOW for moving ~3k sequences and mapping cadence metadata
- Data residency notes (we have EU-based teams that need EU-resident storage for user analytics)
- Any marketplace/partner bundle discounts if we sign HubSpot + Outreach together
- Standard T&Cs and any enterprise addenda (SLAs, uptime, incident response)

I attached a one-page inventory of our current contracts for quick reference (redwood_contracts_summary.xlsx). Can you reply with initial pricing and a sample SOW or quote? If it helps, I'm happy to put calendar time on Claire's Calendly (linked) to walk through specifics.

Thanks — aiming to finalize commercial terms by early October.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Lead, Revenue Productivity
Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the context and the inventory — helpful. We can absolutely propose a combined commercial package that covers Sales Hub seats plus a partner-managed Outreach connector and onboarding. A few clarifying questions before I send a formal quote:
- Can you confirm the expected seat split (CRM vs sequence/engagement licenses)?
- How many of those seats need EU data residency?
- Do you require a committed throughput or API SLA for sequence syncs?

Based on similar customers, I'm including an initial ballpark (see attached HS-Initial-Quote-2025-09-11.pdf). It assumes a 12-month term, 120 total seats with a 15% bundle discount and standard onboarding. If you sign HubSpot + Outreach through our partner program, there's typically an additional $Xk marketplace discount and we can negotiate to waive some integration fees.

I can jump on a call Thursday if you'd like to review line-by-line: https://calendly.com/claire-hubspot/30min

Attached: HS-Initial-Quote-2025-09-11.pdf (attachment: initial bundle estimate)

Best,

Thanks — quick notes from procurement/ops after reviewing the initial quote and our usage: 
- Recommended seat split: 110 HubSpot Sales Hub seats (full CRM + sequences), 25 Outreach seats for advanced orchestration (we can reassign 15 seats after pilot).
- Term: 12 months with option to auto-renew; request a 45-day renewal notice in contract.
- Onboarding/SOW: must include sequence migration (3,000 sequences), cadence metadata mapping, and a 2-week post-migration validation window. Estimate 80-120 hours professional services.
- Compliance: add EU data residency addendum for 12 seats (EMEA SDRs).
- Commercial asks to include in negotiation: 1) waiver of first-30-day onboarding fees, 2) 6-month credits if SLA < 99.5% for sequence syncs, 3) fixed-price migration cap.

I've summarized in procurement_notes.txt and flagged legal for contract review once vendors provide redlines.

— Marcus
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin/Claire —

Thanks for the clear asks. We've put together a combined offer that addresses the migration and connector support:
- 12-month commitment, 120 total seats (110 HubSpot, 25 Outreach — outreach seat pricing assumes sequencing microservices remain on Outreach runtime)
- Bundle discount: 18% off list if both contracts executed within 14 days
- Onboarding/SOW: Outreach will perform the sequence export/mapping and HubSpot will provide connector onboarding. SOW attached: Outreach-HubSpot-Connector-SOW-2025.docx
- Migration cap: fixed fee up to 120 hours; additional hours billed at agreed hourly rate
- EU data residency: available as an addendum for the 12 EMEA seats (we'll provide the standard addendum)
- Marketplace benefit: if HubSpot places Outreach on their partner invoice flow we can waive Outreach's standard onboarding fee (~$12,000)

Attached: Outreach-HubSpot-Connector-SOW-2025.docx, Outreach-HS-Combined-Quote-2025.xlsx

If this looks good, we've provisioned a DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/abc123 — please review and tell us if your legal team needs alternate language.

Best,
Samir Patel
